protocol.input: JSONL from run_detection.py with matching ordered metadata manifest
protocol.missing_output_policy: Counted as missing in coverage and as an empty prediction in metrics.
protocol.failed_output_policy: Retained in status columns. All-manifest metrics conservatively treat an absent accepted finding as negative, so coverage and status must accompany every score.
protocol.out_of_taxonomy_policy: Reported explicitly. The strict generation pipeline rejects such categories before acceptance.
protocol.scrawld_baseline_limitation: Constituent tools are not independent human ground truth.
